subject: Qur'an & Tajweed

intro: Lesson 28. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ دَآئِمُونَ (٢٣) وَٱلَّذِينَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ (٢٤) لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ (٢٥) وَٱلَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ (٢٦) وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ (٢٧) إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَأْمُونٍۢ (٢٨)

وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَٰفِظُونَ (٢٩) إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ (٣٠) فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ (٣١) وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَٰنَٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ (٣٢) وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِشَهَٰدَٰتِهِمْ قَآئِمُونَ (٣٣)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: Those who are constant in their prayer And those within whose wealth is a known right
For the petitioner and the deprived - And those who believe in the Day of Recompense
And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord - Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe -
And those who guard their private parts Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they are not to be blamed -
But whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors - And those who are to their trusts and promises attentive
And those who are in their testimonies upright

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Ma'arij 70:23-33 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 70:23-33 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 70:23-33 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: List four qualities of 'those who pray' from 70:23 to 33.
questions.a: Constant in prayer; give a known right from their wealth; believe in the Day; fear Allah's punishment; guard their chastity; keep trusts and promises; upright in testimony.

questions.q: Why might the list begin and end with prayer (70:23 and 70:34)?
questions.a: Prayer frames the whole character: it is the root of all these qualities.

questions.q: What is in the wealth of the believers (70:24 to 25)?
options: A known right for the one who asks and the deprived
questions.a: A) A known right for the one who asks and the deprived. 70:24 to 25: 'a known right for the petitioner and the deprived'.

questions.q: Al-Ma'arij 70:32: «وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: 70:23 to 33 list the qualities of those who pray. Which quality would most change a school community if everyone had it?
questions.a: Keeping trusts and promises (70:32), or giving to those in need (70:24 to 25), would build trust between everyone.
